# Pictures: 210 effects

<!-- Generated by `pnpm catalog:meta` from the catalog (src/catalog/lazy.test.ts): do not edit. -->

Categories: image, cinematic, film, beauty, distortion, retro, crt, comic, anime, horror, emergency, meme, timewarp, timing, melt. Each line: `id` (kind) what it looks like, what it takes (a subject: image, video, svg, text, mask, path, audio), the text controls words go in, how it answers the pointer, how it suits video, whether it is an overlay, its presets and tags. Check an id before using it: `flair effects --search <words>` or `getEffectMeta(id)`.

## image

- `led-net` (shader) A picture shown through a net of tiny LEDs draped in folds like fabric: each light glows with a cross-shaped star flare, mostly in one cool tint with drifting patches of rainbow colour, dark parts of the picture leaving the lights off so shapes stand out as silhouettes. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Full colour, Rainbow, Flat grid, Fine, Warm. Tags: image, led, light, grid, sparkle, stars, fabric, glow, neon, display.
- `image-ripple` (shader) An image rippling as if seen through water, from the pointer or the centre. Takes image, video, svg. Answers press, pointer. Video: filter. Tags: image, water, interactive, distortion.
- `image-glitch` (shader) Digital glitch on an image: RGB split, slice displacement and blocky corruption in bursts. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Tags: image, glitch, cyber, transition.
- `image-duotone` (shader) An image mapped onto two colours, from its shadows to its highlights. For the gliding glare it used to have, lay `glare-sweep` over it. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Spotify, Newsprint. Tags: image, brand, editorial, colour.
- `image-halftone` (shader) An image printed as rotated halftone dots, breathing slightly. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Tags: image, print, comic, pop-art.
- `image-pixelate` (shader) An image resolving from big blocks to full detail, then back, in a loop. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Tags: image, reveal, transition, 8-bit.
- `image-ken-burns` (shader) A slow documentary-style pan and zoom across an image, easing in and out and back again. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Push in, Pull out, Slow drift. Tags: image, camera, documentary, slideshow.
- `image-ascii` (shader) An image drawn as text characters picked by brightness, in one ink or the picture's own colours. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Terminal, Colour, Typewriter. Tags: image, ascii, text, terminal, retro.
- `image-shatter` (shader) An image breaking into glass-like shards that fly apart, spin and reassemble in a loop. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Burst, Crackle. Tags: image, shatter, transition, voronoi, explode.
- `image-melt` (shader) An image melting and dripping downwards in slow, noisy runs. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Slow ooze, Meltdown. Tags: image, melt, drip, psychedelic, distortion.
- `image-risograph` (shader) An image printed in two posterized, slightly misregistered inks on grainy paper. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Pink & blue, Sunflower & teal, Red & black. Tags: image, print, riso, editorial, poster.
- `image-thermal` (shader) An image seen through a heat camera or night-vision goggles. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Thermal, Night vision. Tags: image, thermal, night-vision, surveillance, colour.
- `image-edge-glow` (shader) An image's edges traced as glowing neon lines over a dimmed picture, with a travelling pulse. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Cyan, Magenta blackout. Tags: image, neon, edges, outline, cyber.

## cinematic

- `anamorphic-lens` (shader) A picture through an anamorphic cinema lens: its highlights throw long horizontal streaks and soft oval glows, and the frame bows a little towards its sides. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Sci-fi blue, Amber, Night city, Subtle. Tags: cinematic, film, lens, anamorphic, flare, streak, image.
- `rack-focus` (shader) A focus puller racking between two points in a picture: one sharp while the rest falls into soft lens blur with highlights opening into discs, then the focus pulls across to the other and back. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Shallow, Anamorphic, Gentle. Tags: cinematic, film, focus, lens, blur, bokeh, depth-of-field, image.
- `bleach-bypass` (shader) A picture graded like film that skipped the bleach: the silver left in lays a black-and-white image over the colour, draining saturation, hardening contrast and crushing the blacks to a gritty metallic look. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: War film, Steel blue, Warm bronze, Subtle. Tags: cinematic, film, grade, colour-grade, gritty, desaturated, image.
- `technicolor` (shader) A picture printed like three-strip (or two-strip) dye-transfer film: separate colour records laid down as dyes, saturated primaries, a warm print and a slight misregistration between the records. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Two-strip, Musical, Faded print. Tags: cinematic, film, grade, colour-grade, vintage, saturated, image.
- `day-for-night` (shader) A daylight picture graded into moonlit night, the way films shot night scenes by day: underexposed, drained of colour, tinted moonlight blue, with the bright sky darkened and the shadows lifted a touch. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Deep night, Silver moon, Dusk. Tags: cinematic, film, grade, colour-grade, night, moonlight, blue, image.
- `trailer-title-slam` (shader) A film-trailer title hit: brushed-metal letters slam down out of the dark with a flash, a shake and a burst of dust, a lens flare glints across them, they hold and fade back to black. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Presets: Gold, Blood red, No dust, Held title. Tags: cinematic, film, trailer, title, metal, flare, impact, text.
- `dolly-zoom` (shader) The vertigo shot: the subject holds its size in the middle of the frame while the background behind it stretches towards the camera or falls away, as when a camera dollies one way and zooms the other. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Vertigo, Falling away, Unease, Held. Tags: cinematic, film, camera, dolly, vertigo, zoom, warp, dramatic, image.
- `opening-credits` (vector) A film's opening credits: one card at a time, a small tracked lead over a name, each fading in while it eases larger and fading out, ending on the film's title. Takes text. Words go in `credits`. Presets: Over video, Gold, Quick. Tags: cinematic, film, credits, intro, title.
- `end-credits-roll` (vector) A film's end credits rolling up the screen: the title, then section headings and roles beside their names in two columns, fading at the top and bottom of the frame. Takes text. Words go in `title`, `credits`. Presets: Classic, Gold, Over video, Fast. Tags: cinematic, film, credits, end-card, outro, scroll, title.

## film

- `letterbox` (shader) Black bars that frame any picture to a cinema aspect ratio: top and bottom for a wider ratio (2.39 scope, 1.85 flat), at the sides for a narrower one (4:3). Animate slides them in and out. Overlay. Presets: Scope 2.39, Flat 1.85, Academy 4:3, Slide in. Tags: cinematic, film, letterbox, aspect-ratio, overlay, frame.
- `academy-leader` (shader) The countdown at the head of a film reel: 8 down to 3 in a ringed circle under crosshairs, a sweep going round each second, worn with dust, scratches and flicker; the 2 flashes for a frame and the screen goes black. Presets: Clean, Battered, Sepia. Tags: cinematic, film, countdown, leader, vintage, intro, projector.
- `cinema-projector` (shader) A picture showing on a cinema screen in a dark auditorium: it flickers and weaves in the gate, a dusty projector beam fans down onto it, its light spills onto the curtains, and a row of heads sits silhouetted in front. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Scope screen, Old picture house, Empty house. Tags: cinematic, film, cinema, projector, screen, audience, vintage, image.
- `film-strip` (shader) A picture running through a strip of film: frame after frame of it sliding past between rows of sprocket holes, with frame lines, printed edge marks along the margin and a little dust and flicker, lit from behind as on a lightbox; upright or across, tilted if you like, or as an orange-based negative. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Across, Negative, Tilted, Dark room, Overlay. Tags: film, cinema, sprockets, film-strip, 35mm, negative, vintage, image.
- `film-damage` (shader) A picture as a battered old print: scratches running down it that come and go, dust and the odd hair flashing past for a frame, emulsion blotches, flicker and a faded colour, the frame jumping at bad splices and a cue mark blinking in the corner. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Grindhouse, Archive, Light wear. Tags: film, cinema, scratches, dust, damage, vintage, grain, projector, image.
- `dramatic-letterbox` (shader) A picture's big moment: cinema bars slam in from the top and bottom, bouncing and shaking the frame as they land, while the picture pushes slowly in and the grade turns moody, contrasty and teal and orange; then it all eases back. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Scope slam, Ultra wide, Noir, Gentle. Tags: film, cinematic, letterbox, dramatic, trailer, aspect-ratio, grade, image.
- `film-projector` (vector) A vintage film projector running: its two reels turning, the film feeding through it from one to the other, and a flickering cone of light streaming from its lens with dust drifting through the beam, on a seamless loop. Presets: Chrome, Dark room, Warm beam. Tags: film, cinema, projector, film-reel, vintage, movie, icon, loop.

## timewarp

- `time-echo` (shader) A swaying picture trailed by fading, tinted ghost echoes of where it just was. Takes image, video, svg. Video: stills. Presets: Trails, Strobe, Neon ghosts. Tags: time, image, echo, trail, ghost.
- `chrono-split` (shader) Red, green and blue each lagging a little further behind in time, so movement leaves colour fringes. Takes image, video, svg. Video: stills. Presets: Subtle, Prism. Tags: time, image, rgb, chromatic, echo.
- `time-slice` (shader) Bands of a moving picture each showing a different moment, staggered like a time-displacement. Takes image, video, svg. Video: stills. Presets: Venetian, Shuffle. Tags: time, image, slices, stagger, displacement.
- `rewind` (shader) A tape playing, then rewinding fast with tracking noise, jittering lines, colour bleed and a ◀◀ display. Takes image, video, svg. Video: stills. Presets: Worn tape, Clean deck, Green OSD. Tags: time, image, vhs, retro, rewind, tape.
- `bullet-time` (shader) A shockwave sweeping out from the centre or a click, freezing the picture grey and zoomed behind it while the rest moves on. Takes image, video, svg. Answers click. Video: stills. Presets: Slow wave, Snap. Tags: time, image, freeze, shockwave, click, cinematic, interactive.
- `time-tunnel` (shader) A picture wrapped round a spiralling tunnel rushing at the viewer, with light streaks and a blazing core. Takes image, video, svg. Video: filter. Presets: Vortex, Ember, True colour. Tags: time, image, tunnel, vortex, sci-fi, warp.
- `speed-ramp` (shader) A panning picture lurching from a crawl to a blur and back, motion-blurred in proportion to its speed. Takes image, video, svg. Video: stills. Presets: Gentle, Whip. Tags: time, image, speed, motion-blur, cinematic.
- `stutter-freeze` (shader) A moving picture that catches in irregular bursts, holding or stuttering frames with a flash on each freeze. Takes image, video, svg. Video: stills. Presets: Nervous, Long holds. Tags: time, image, freeze, stutter, glitch.
- `time-lapse-clock` (vector) A clock whose hands race round while the sky behind turns from day to dusk, night and dawn. Presets: Pastel, Mono. Tags: time, clock, time-lapse, day, night, loader.

## timing

- `retime-speed` (timing) Footage played slower or faster throughout: slow motion with blended in-between frames, or a sped-up time-lapse with its motion blurred. Takes video. Presets: Slow motion, Double speed, Time-lapse, Choppy slow motion. Tags: timing, retime, speed, slow-motion, time-lapse, video.
- `retime-ramp` (timing) Footage that eases from full speed into slow motion round one moment and back out again, like a sports replay. Takes video. Presets: Sports replay, Gentle, Snap. Tags: timing, retime, speed, ramp, slow-motion, sport, replay, video.
- `retime-reverse` (timing) Footage played backwards from its last frame to its first. Takes video. Presets: Rewind, Slow reverse. Tags: timing, retime, reverse, rewind, backwards, video.
- `retime-boomerang` (timing) Footage played forwards then backwards, again and again, sped up like a social-media boomerang. Takes video. Presets: Quick, Lazy. Tags: timing, retime, boomerang, loop, ping-pong, reverse, social, video.
- `retime-freeze` (timing) Footage that stops dead on one frame, holds it, then plays on from where it stopped. Takes video. Presets: Beat, Long hold, Opening still. Tags: timing, retime, freeze, freeze-frame, hold, pause, video.
- `retime-stutter` (timing) Footage that catches on short snatches, replaying each a few times before it moves on, like a skipping record. Takes video. Presets: Glitch, Beat repeat. Tags: timing, retime, stutter, repeat, glitch, skip, music-video, video.
- `retime-step` (timing) Footage that holds each frame a while at a low frame rate, for a choppy stop-motion or animated-on-twos look. Takes video. Presets: On twos, Stop motion, Slideshow. Tags: timing, retime, frame-rate, stop-motion, choppy, on-twos, video.
- `frame-echo` (timing) Each frame of footage with fading copies of the frames just before it, so moving things leave a trail of ghosts. Takes video. Presets: Onion skin, Light ghosts. Tags: timing, echo, ghost, trail, onion-skin, video.
- `long-exposure` (timing) Footage seen through a shutter held open: moving water turns silky and crowds melt away, or the brightest lights draw streaks, while whatever stays still stays sharp. Takes video. Presets: Silky water, Light trails, Empty streets, Building trails. Tags: timing, long-exposure, light-trails, motion-blur, photography, silky, night, video.
